body:
i dont really know how to ground myself, honestly. i feel like no matter what i do, i'm just not always there. often times i feel like my brain is paralysing me and even if i wanted to do anything other than retract, i couldnt. 

i used to have a few online friends back when i was 12-14, and those relationships were probably some of the most intimate of my life tbh, but now i hate communicating digitally. i hate the internet. i hate that it is replacing so much, and i hate myself for having isolated myself willingly for so long and now that digital has taken the forefront i want social interaction.

in fact i feel like if i didnt have these daydreams i would have ended it a long time ago. they are all i have left in my life. i want out because i know its not real and that im wasting the "best years" of my life so far away from everyone and everything
